node_config: config/zenobia-node.json (8 cores 0-7: one partition, zenobia, with the GPU; aliases spheral, raikou-mfem, powerflow; borrow.backfill_waiting_owners true; everything else as 0.6.2); config/zenobia-16core-node.json (the same on cores 0-15 of the Ryzen 9 9950X3D2, SMT siblings 16-31, lease files testing-core<K>.lock for K = 8-15)

database_schema.change: none (rows unchanged; old partition names resolved through aliases)

features: no partitions on zenobia: one pool, zenobia, of every physical core and the GPU; every job requests from it

partition aliases (node.json partitions[].aliases): plain names or objects with default_cpus, default_mem, default_time and prefer_cpus; every partition-by-name lookup resolves them (submit, run, --test-only, --borrow-from, ensemble submit, scheduler, borrow planner, GPU line, adoption, simq partitions, simq doctor, simq show)

jobs keep the name they were submitted with (database, listings, SIMQ_PARTITION, idempotency fingerprint); jobs recorded under spheral, raikou-mfem or powerflow before 0.6.3 are adopted and scheduled in the pool

the alias defaults are the 0.6.2 partitions' (spheral 4 cores 18G 2 days; raikou-mfem and powerflow 2 cores 4G 12 h) and their old cores are tried first; without -p the old default partition's defaults apply; limits are the pool's (20G, 14 days)

borrow.backfill_waiting_owners: a free core a waiting owner job needs is lent to a borrow job whose time limit ends before that owner job's earliest start (EASY backfill for borrow jobs); false keeps the 0.6.1 rule

simq run (alias srun): the options of simq submit; submits, prints the job ID on stderr, streams the job's combined log to stdout, waits, exits with the job's exit code (signal N: 128+N; else 0 succeeded, 1 otherwise; never 0 for a job that did not succeed); SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP cancel the job and exit 130/143/129; --idempotency-key reattaches a replay to the existing job
explicit smt_siblings in node.json are checked against sysfs when the topology is checked

upgrade.py install/rollback 0.6.2 <-> 0.6.3 (dry run by default): preflight allows the partition layout change and checks that no core, GPU or partition name (of the live config and of every queued or active job) is lost; backup, adoption of job and GPU claim units, GPU line state verification, automatic rollback; rollback lists jobs queued under the pool name
